en: Morning, Ryoma.

Oh, it's you...and Shuichi too, huh?
You guys are always together.
Whaaat? We're not *always* together...

Hmph, well not "always," but I feel like 
whenever I see one of you, the other's nearby.
I-Is that right...?

Well, it's not a bad thing. You can't protect 
yourself when you're alone.
Huh?

I thought something would happen at night...
when it's easiest to get someone alone...

But everyone's safe and nothing 
all that bad has happened.
Of course! No one would do that!
Hmph...I said it before, but...

If you really want to live through a 
situation like this, grumbling won't help.
What...?

I understand that you want to believe
in everyone, but...

Idealistic thoughts like that won't save anyone.
You might end up losing what you tried to save.
What do you mean by that?
Who knows...? I've talked too much.

Anyway...you guys only have a little bit 
of time left to think.

That's the situation. The best thing to do 
is live life with confidence.
That's all I can say.
Don't forget it...

If you really want to live through a 
situation like this, grumbling won't help.
Good morning.
Morning, Rantaro.

Good morning, Rantaro... Ah, actually,
may I ask you a question?
Hm? What's up?

Being questioned by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=typeNORMAL> 
is making me kind of nervous.

No, well, it's not...
It's nothing bad.

Haha, I know, I'm just teasing.
What's up, Shuichi?

I wanted to know what you meant
by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Oh, yeah! I wanted to know about that too!

I told you, it's nothing.
Just forget about it.
But...

Look, like I told you before,
I was just a little confused.

Not being able to remember my own
talent is...stressing me out.

Really, I would appreciate it if you
didn't ask me about it anymore.

I understand. Sorry if it seemed
like I was interrogating you.

No, no...
I'm sorry that I'm not much help.
Well then, I'll see you later.

Hey, Shuichi... Do you think Rantaro is really
just confused?
I don't know, but...

He certainly doesn't want to talk about it.
We shouldn't ask him any more questions...

Yeah... We should be focusing on exposing
the mastermind.
Morning, Keebo.
Ah, good morning.

Your timing is impeccable. I have something
I wish to ask you both.
Huh? What is it, Keebo?

What are your thoughts on this door?
No matter how hard I try, it will not open...
Um, well...it doesn't seem like an exit...

What do you think is on the other side
of this wall?

Why don't you just fly over and see
for yourself?
Whoa—!?
K-Kokichi!?
C'mon! I wanna see you fly!

Robots have jet packs or whatever under
their feet, right?
Whaaat!? You...don't...?
...No, I don't.
...Have a dick?
Wh-What are you talking about!?
Oh, yeah! If you had a jet pack...

...then you could've flown over the wall
and called for help!

Geeeez! You're just a huge disappointment,
Keebo!
K-Keebo?
...I'm fine. Please just let it be.
I...don't like sci-fi functions like flight.
<CLT=cltMIND>But aren't you already pretty sci-fi?
<CLT=cltMIND>Um...it might be better to leave them alone...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>This door was blocked before...
When did it become accessible?

<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Area Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick
(Closed)

<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Area Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick
(Open)
